title: Palazzo del Bo

terrainReference.basis: Original public elevation on the street-side pavement west of the palace. Courtyard levels and thresholds are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: Native OpenStreetMap named relation and seven constituent ways, verified against the University of Padua and national heritage record.
mapIdentity.scope: Exact street footprint, all six mapped enclosed courts and the independently mapped Bo tower. Original Qualla and CC0 photographs support the covered courtyard and theatre.

note: The University archive describes the columned courts and modern tower shortening. Exact exterior and court levels, roof junctions, facade rhythms and the internal position of the theatre are approximate.
